title: NP-2 workspace and NP-3 editor core baseline slice

live_observation.reason: No authorized signed-in Notion browser session was available for this catalog slice. Official pages are references only; no UI, DOM, accessibility-tree, network, or visual state was captured.

scope.description: First NP-0 catalog slice for workspace navigation, IAM, page lifecycle, block editing, keyboard behavior, and save-conflict characterization. It is not an exhaustive NP-2 or NP-3 inventory.

sources.title: Navigate with the sidebar
sources.claim_summary: The official help page describes workspace switching, sidebar sections, nesting, collapse, drag-and-drop reorganization, favorites, private pages, shared pages, teamspaces, and trash navigation.

sources.title: Sharing and permissions
sources.claim_summary: The official help page is the reference for members, guests, page access levels, sharing, and permission behavior; no plan-role combination was exercised here.

sources.title: Duplicate, delete and restore content
sources.claim_summary: The official help page is the reference for duplicating content, moving content to trash, restoring it, and page history availability.

sources.title: Writing and editing basics
sources.claim_summary: The official help page describes content types, rich text, block selection, drag-and-drop, Markdown shortcuts, inline mentions, and a distinct mobile editing toolbar.

sources.title: What is a block?
sources.claim_summary: The official help page is the block-model reference. This catalog does not infer serialization or unsupported-block round-trip behavior from it.

sources.title: Keyboard shortcuts
sources.claim_summary: The official help page lists desktop and Markdown shortcuts and explicitly frames its instructions around English/QWERTY keyboards.

reference_conflicts.summary: The sidebar reference states that moving shared content into Private removes others' access, while the sharing reference owns the broader page, guest, group, and inherited permission model. The precise cross-surface capability matrix is not fully specified by either reference alone.
reference_conflicts.impact: Do not infer search, mention, relation, comment, public-link, or API visibility from sidebar placement. Each role and surface requires authorized live characterization.

reference_conflicts.summary: The shortcut reference is scoped to English/QWERTY keyboards, while the writing reference describes a separate mobile toolbar and states that mobile has no slash commands. Neither source characterizes Korean IME composition across every listed platform.
reference_conflicts.impact: Desktop shortcut, mobile editing, Korean IME, focus, and caret expectations remain separate samples and cannot be generalized across profiles.

scenarios.title: Navigate, collapse, favorite, and reorder the workspace sidebar

preconditions.statement: Use a synthetic workspace containing nested Private, Shared, Teamspace, and favorite pages appropriate to the selected profile.
The selected role has no permissions beyond those declared by its fixture.

assertions.expected: Collapse and expansion preserve the nested page tree and the active page.
Favorite and drag operations produce only role-authorized sidebar state changes.
Keyboard and pointer operations restore focus to an observable sidebar target.

evidence.unverified_reason: The official help page was reviewed, but the actions were not executed in an authorized Notion session.

records.description: Official documentation reference only; not a live capture.

scenarios.notes: Ordering, hover targets, focus restoration, narrow viewport behavior, and plan-specific sections remain uncharacterized.

scenarios.title: Apply role and page permission boundaries without cross-surface leakage

preconditions.statement: Create synthetic parent and child pages with explicit fixture members, guests, and access levels.
Prepare inaccessible sibling content with a unique synthetic marker for leakage detection.

assertions.expected: A profile cannot discover content or metadata outside its effective permission.
Parent, child, explicit share, and workspace-role interactions produce a profile-specific capability matrix.
Denied mutations do not partially change page, permission, audit, or publication state.

evidence.unverified_reason: Official references establish sharing and sidebar concepts but do not resolve the complete cross-surface plan-role capability matrix.

records.description: Official sharing documentation reference only; no permission matrix was executed.
Official sidebar documentation reference only; no permission matrix was executed.

scenarios.notes: The open scope ambiguity blocks live-characterized and differential-passed claims until each surface is sampled.

scenarios.title: Duplicate, trash, and restore a page tree without confusing Second Brain purge policy

preconditions.statement: Use a synthetic parent page with a child, backlink, and disabled public link.
The selected profile has fixture permission to perform each requested lifecycle action.

assertions.expected: Duplicate, trash, and restore transitions preserve a coherent page subtree and stable observable identity rules.
Lifecycle transitions do not broaden page, backlink, or public-link access.
Notion-style trash behavior does not deactivate or purge Second Brain knowledge, and it does not alter the administrator-only 90-day purge eligibility contract.

evidence.unverified_reason: Official lifecycle references were recorded, but no plan-role lifecycle was executed.

records.description: Official duplicate, delete, and restore reference only.

scenarios.notes: Retention duration, permanent-delete authority, subtree identity, backlink behavior, and public-link effects require separate profile samples.

scenarios.title: Create, transform, move, select, and round-trip representative blocks

preconditions.statement: Open an editable synthetic page with one empty text block and no external embeds.
Record the selected profile and platform before any action.

assertions.expected: Each supported block retains type, content, rich-text marks, order, and parent after reload.
Selection and transform commands produce a deterministic block selection and caret result.
Unsupported or degraded blocks are preserved by an explicit round-trip policy rather than silently dropped.

evidence.unverified_reason: Official references describe blocks and platform-specific editing, but no cross-platform action sequence or round-trip was observed.

records.description: Official writing and editing documentation reference only.

scenarios.notes: This sample intentionally excludes external embed payloads and does not claim block-schema parity.

scenarios.title: Characterize desktop shortcuts, Korean IME boundaries, focus, and mobile divergence

preconditions.statement: Use a Korean input method on a synthetic editable page and record exact OS, app or browser, and input-method versions in future live evidence.
Start with a known text block, collapsed selection, and empty undo history.

assertions.expected: Composition commits complete grapheme clusters without duplicate, missing, or prematurely split text.
Enter, Backspace, Tab, menu navigation, undo, and redo have profile-specific deterministic results.
Menus dismiss to the originating editor surface with a preserved observable caret or selection.
Every keyboard-reachable command exposes an accessible name, role, state, and visible focus indication.

evidence.unverified_reason: The official shortcut reference is English/QWERTY-scoped and no Korean IME or platform sample was captured.

records.description: Official desktop/mobile editing distinction reference only.

scenarios.notes: Mobile editing is retained as a separate future scenario because the official reference describes different controls and no slash commands.

scenarios.title: Preserve a dirty draft across autosave retry, stale revision, and peek transitions

preconditions.statement: Open the same synthetic page revision in two authorized clients.
Keep client A dirty while client B commits a conflicting revision.
Use only isolated test storage; live user_data, knowledge, .runtime, sessions, and workspace paths are forbidden.

assertions.expected: A stale save does not overwrite the acknowledged revision or discard client A's draft.
A failed save creates no partial page, block, revision, idempotency, audit, outbox, or Second Brain publication mutation.
Main, side-peek, center-peek, and full-page transitions retain the same recoverable dirty draft until explicit resolution.

evidence.unverified_reason: The cited writing reference does not define autosave conflict wire or recovery semantics, and no live product observation was performed.

records.description: Official editor scope reference only; it does not evidence conflict behavior.

scenarios.notes: Repository behavior, contract tests, live characterization, and differential results must be attached as separate evidence before any promotion status is set.
